program.title: BSc in Quantitative Finance
uncertain: total_required_credits (41.0) is the sum of the required_credits of all groups. The MATH 1014/1024 block has a 0-3 range (exemption for students who took MATH 1020 for School Requirements), and the MATH 2011/2023 block has a 3-4 range, so the actual credits may differ from the lower-bound calculation.

Area A (Finance) of the QFIN Restricted Electives is 'Any FINA courses at 3000- or 4000-level', a free choice with no fixed printed list; only Area B and Area C enumerated course lists are included in the courses array.

The PDF header/footer shows '2026-27 QFIN (4Y) (2025-26 intake)', i.e. the document is the 2025-26 intake curriculum rendered on a 2026-27 template; the year is recorded as 2025-26 per the intake year.
